item.title: Can the stockmarket swallow Anthropic, SpaceX and OpenAI?
How is Groq raising more money?
item.description:
📝 That corporate entity continued to operate, focusing on maintaining Groq’s datacenters and their inference API. When Nvidia licensed Groq’s technology, Groq’s chip design team, compiler team, and software team joined Nvidia, but Groq’s datacenter team stayed to maintain GroqCloud inference services. One could argue that Groq’s datacenters alone could make them worth billions of dollars.

item.title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now available on AWS
item.description:

item.title: U.S. Midterms Have a Cyber Problem, but It's Not at the Ballot Box
item.description:
📝 Midterm Election Threat Outlook to see the complete intelligence picture → More Than 4,000 Election-themed Domains Were Registered in a Single Month Check Point Exposure Management tracked newly registered domains containing election-related terms across two windows in early 2026. In January, approximately 1,300 domains containing “election” and roughly 2,957 containing “vote” were registered. Check Point’s 2026 Cyber Security Report found that 82% of malicious file attacks were delivered by email.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.checkpoint.com/exposure-management/the-2026-u-s-midterms-have-a-cyber-problem-but-its-not-at-the-ballot-box/

item.title: Age verification for social media, the beginning of the end for a free internet?
item.description:
📝 The big tech social media companies are bad. Introducing age verification is based on the state being able to force social media companies to verify their users’ identities. But the big tech social media platforms already know which of their users are children.
